meta.title: Price-Trend Dashboard: refused for a user without the Category Manager role
gaps: Sign in as both the non-Category Manager user and the Category Manager in the same Enterprise tenant
Verify or change the tenant's Enterprise plan and RBAC role configuration
Observe and compare the role-specific refusal or availability of the Price-Trend Dashboard
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as both the non-Category Manager user and the Category Manager in the same Enterprise tenant; Verify or change the tenant's Enterprise plan and RBAC role configuration; Observe and compare the role-specific refusal or availability of the Price-Trend Dashboard

steps.note: Open an existing event as the closest available route to the Price Trends area.
Navigate to the event's Price Trends view, which is the closest catalog representation of the requested dashboard.

args.need: sign in as the non-Category Manager user and the Category Manager in the same Enterprise tenant, then attempt Price-Trend Dashboard access and compare the refusal or availability

steps.note: Role-specific sign-in and access comparison are not expressible by the catalog.
Confirm the Price Trends view remains identifiable after the role comparison.
